versions.content: If an DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationCallback is configured for the referenced DoIPRoutingAct ivation, the DoIP module shall call this callback (for the signature see <User>_DoIPRoutingActivationAuthentication, SWS_DoIP_00049). If the DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationReqLength is not configured to 0, the DoIP module shall handle additionally the first DoIPRoutingActivationAuthenticationReqLength bytes of the optional field “OEM specific”.
